newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Kondarl suspended on rights offer plan.
newsitem.headline: Kondarl suspended on rights offer plan.

text.p: Shares of poultry and feed processor Shenzhen Kondarl Group Co Ltd were suspended on the Shenzhen bourse on Thursday after it said it planned a 1.875-for-10 rights offer.

The rights issue, to be discussed at a shareholders' meeting in Shenzhen on March 10, has been tentatively priced at between four and seven yuan per share, Kondarl said in a statement in Shenzhen-based Securities Times.
The issue is based on its current total share capital of 132.48 million shares.
Kondarl, also involved in passenger transport, said it would use the rights proceeds to construct a bus station, expand its taxi fleet and boost chicken feed production.

On Wednesday, Kondarl's A shares closed at 12.20 yuan. Trading in the company's shares was suspended on Thursday morning pending the announcement and will resume in the afternoon, the Shenzhen bourse said.
Kondarl reported after-tax profits of 30.68 million yuan for 1995, up 2.39 percent from 29.96 million yuan in 1994.
The firm, which exports most of its chickens to Hong Kong, said earnings were fueled by strong demand but were capped by high grain prices.
